tools.name: JSON Utilities
tools.description: Clean, format, validate, and diff JSON data. All processing happens in your browser - no data is sent to any server.
tools.heroExtra: Clean removes comments, fixes quotes, handles MongoDB syntax, and repairs malformed JSON. If validation or formatting fails, try using Clean first to fix syntax errors.

tools.name: Image Editor
tools.description: Powerful image manipulation tool with resize, crop, rotate, effects, and format conversion. All processing happens in your browser - no data is sent to any server. Supports various import and export formats listed below, with full metadata support for EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and ICC profiles.
tools.heroExtra: Wide format browser or tablet recommended for best editing experience.

tools.name: Hash Generator
tools.description: Generate cryptographic hashes and checksums from text or data using popular algorithms like SHA-256, MD5, SHA-3, and more. All processing happens in your browser - no data is sent to any server.

tools.name: UUID Generator
tools.description: Generate unique identifiers (UUIDs) instantly. All generation happens in your browser - no data is sent to any server.

tools.name: Barcode Generator
tools.description: Generate various types of barcodes and QR codes for different use cases.

tools.name: Passphrase Generator
tools.description: Generate human memorable natural language or secure random passphrases.

tools.name: Diff Utilities
tools.description: Compare text, JSON, CSS, and array data with visual diff highlighting.

tools.name: Data Workbench
tools.description: Browser-based BI tool for CSV, JSON, Parquet, and Excel files. Convert between formats, run SQL queries, and analyze data entirely in your browser. All processing happens locally - no data leaves your browser.
tools.heroExtra: Supports CSV ⇄ JSON ⇄ Parquet ⇄ Excel conversions with advanced SQL analytics. Features auto-schema detection, statistics generation, full-text search, and a complete SQL console for complex queries. Powered by DuckDB extensions: excel, fts, json, parquet.

tools.name: Closed Loop
tools.description: Secure private connection for sharing files and text between devices using WebRTC.
